name: IPCAI 2025 paired X-ray and CT set of the distal femur (Flepp 2025, Zenodo 15753063)
what: one zip, dataset_ipcai.zip, 6.7 GB (md5 cc8bf3e445495d2deb6d50dd058dc977): 50 real calibrated X-rays of 5 cadaveric distal femur specimens (ten views each, about 9 degrees apart, Siemens Fluorospot), their 5 CTs at 0.2 mm slices, the poses, the contour masks and the bone models, from 'Automatic multi-view X-ray/CT registration using bone substructure contours' (Flepp and others, IPCAI 2025, arXiv 2506.13292); the femur, no spine
level_truth: none; no spine; the stored poses make it a 2D/3D registration benchmark (docs/research/benchmarks-to-beat.md, sections 1 and 5)
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21 as 'pelvis or spine, to confirm'; on the grid at the X-ray chain's destination (grid/fetch-xray.json) and still zipped at the sample index of 2026-10-22 (4 files, 6.2 GB, docs/research/data-manifest/MANIFEST.md); the Zenodo page and the paper, read on 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23, say the distal femur, so it names no level, enters no registry shard (its registry entry was removed on 2026-10-23) and serves workstream O (#127) as a registration benchmark only
licence: Research-Only Dataset License (the Zenodo record: redistribution for academic research only, commercial use by written permission, Swiss law); the code is by request under a non-commercial licence, patent pending EP25168706.7
how_to_get: Open https://zenodo.org/records/15753063: open access, no login; one file, dataset_ipcai.zip, 6.7 GB, md5 cc8bf3e445495d2deb6d50dd058dc977.

Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py zenodo-get --record 15753063 --dest DIR (the X-ray chain's entry ipcai2025_xray_ct in grid/fetch-xray.json names the same record and destination).
Unzip as a job and read the file layout before any use; grid/banks/ipcai2025_xray_ct.json still says to confirm it, and nothing of the set enters a shard, since it holds no spine.
